version.promotionalText: Private cadet rosters, approved photo pages, hidden previews, saved finds, family notes, and a plain-English academy terms guide.
version.description:
CadetCatch helps Coast Guard Academy families keep up with cadet photos without digging through every gallery by hand.

Create a private roster on your iPhone, add approved photo pages, check those pages for possible face matches, review match details, view selected results, save likely finds, and keep simple notes for family follow-up.

CadetCatch checks only photo pages you add or enable. Private albums stay private unless you choose to share an accessible link.

Privacy Policy: https://eb28.co/cc/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
version.whatsNew: Restores the build 80 CadetCatch update with private roster setup, approved public photo sources, hidden result previews, saved finds, family notes, and purchase restore controls.

notes: Add a cadet profile from Roster using a clear face photo selected from Photos.

Open Sources to confirm Coast Guard Academy, DVIDS, and Pduddy Pics are selected, or add another secure public photo page. Facebook photo or album links can also be added when the reviewer has permission to open the link in Safari.

Open Home and run Check Photos. The app shows the current source, discovered image count, checked image count, and possible match count while scanning. Previews stay hidden until single-photo or monthly access is active.
Open Photos to review possible matches, view a photo, save it, and create a family note.

Open Photo Access from More or a locked photo. The monthly subscription screen shows Family Monthly, 1 month, the monthly price, auto-renewal text, Restore Purchases, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Use (EULA) before purchase.
If a page has no usable images or no likely match, the app shows that result instead of showing unrelated results.

testedFlows: add cadet with selected profile photo
photo check with hidden result previews and empty/no-match handling
purchase sheet with visible Family Monthly title, 1 month duration, price per month, auto-renewal disclosure, Privacy Policy link, Terms of Use (EULA) link, and restore purchase controls
photo review, view, and saved photo flow
daily photo check toggle in More
knownRisks: Public websites may change markup or block automated image access; the app surfaces empty/no-match results when a page cannot provide usable public images.
Private Facebook group/media access is not included in this build; this build supports public Facebook photo pages and Facebook links that the reviewer can open in Safari.

Build 80 uses the supplied low-resolution USCGC EAGLE photo from the owner as the native iOS launch/splash image and welcome image, with the screenshot UI badge removed and no replacement EAGLE artwork.
In-app purchase products must be active in App Store Connect before TestFlight purchase flows can return live products.
